{{Quote|I'm not like you! I'm just a man!|Gantrell to the Hero of Tython|<ref name="Star Wars: The Old Republic">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''</ref>}}
'''Gantrell''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Scientist/Legends|scientist]] who worked on [[Belsavis/Legends|Belsavis]] during the [[Galactic War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|resurgent Sith Empire]].

==Biography==
Around [[3641 BBY]], he worked for the [[High Security Section]] and studied the [[Rakata/Legends|Rakatan]] [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]] [[Power core/Legends|power core]] until he was captured by [[Executor (Sith Empire rank)|Executor]] [[Krannus]]. Before his arrest, he was able to send a distress call to [[Pak Taldine]] after his capture. He was put in [[Vault S-31]] and left to [[Death/Legends|die]]. After the [[Hero of Tython]] arrived and killed an ancient [[Sithspawn/Legends|Sithspawn]] called a [[Terentatek/Legends|terentatek]], Gantrell was terrified and explained that Krannus intended to detonate the planet's core, which would result in a [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]] shockwave that would consume Belsavis, its [[Belsavis system/Legends|entire system]] and all of the adjacent [[Star system/Legends|star systems]] as well. Gantrell begged the Hero not to leave him in the dangerous vault, so the Jedi agreed to seal the doctor in one of the vault's secure chambers before heading deeper into the prison.

==Appearances==
*''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' {{1st}}
